AccountingResponseStatus.description: Normalized TACACS+ accounting reply status values.

oneOf.description:
`TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_SUCCESS` (`0x01`) indicates the accounting record
was accepted successfully by the TACACS+ server.

`TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_ERROR` (`0x02`) indicates the server rejected the
accounting operation or encountered an error processing it.

`TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_FOLLOW` (`0x21`) indicates the client should
continue with a follow-up action defined by the server deployment.
Execute a single TACACS+ accounting transaction.

command.description: Command name to report, matching the TACACS+ `cmd` accounting argument.

command_arguments.description: Additional command arguments encoded as TACACS+ `cmd-arg` values.

port.description: NAS or tty/port identifier reported to the TACACS+ server.

remote_address.description: Remote client address to report in the TACACS+ accounting record.

user.description: TACACS+ username associated with the command being accounted for.

oneOf.description: Successful TACACS+ accounting reply from the selected upstream server.

data.description: Optional opaque data returned by the TACACS+ server.

server.description: Upstream TACACS+ server that handled the request.

server_message.description: Human-readable message returned by the TACACS+ server.

status.description:
TACACS+ accounting reply status.

This abstracts the RFC 8907 accounting status octet:
- `success` => `TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_SUCCESS` (`0x01`)
- `error` => `TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_ERROR` (`0x02`)
- `follow` => `TAC_PLUS_ACCT_STATUS_FOLLOW` (`0x21`)

message.description: Error text suitable for logs and operator-facing diagnostics.

retriable.description: Whether retrying against the service may succeed after failover or recovery.

server.description: Upstream server associated with the error, if one had already been chosen.
